 Order
With the consent of learned counsel for the appellant, the matter is heard finally at motion stage.

This appeal has been filed by the claimant/appellant under Section 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act,
1988 against the award dated 28.06.2023 passed in MACC.No.1554 of 2021 by Member MACT Bhopal seeking reduction of compensation amount.
2. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that in the instant case, deceased was aged 5 years at the time of incident but Tribunal has awarded Rs.5,71,000/-.
Therefore, compensation awarded by the Tribunal be suitably reduced.
3. I have heard learned counsel for the appellant and perused the record of the case.
4. Perusal of impugned award reveals that on the date of accident, deceased's was aged 4 years 11 months.
Tribunal has determined deceased's notional income as Rs.30,000/- per annum and has applied multiplier of 15.
Tribunal has also added Rs.16,500/- each for loss of estate and funeral expenses.
Tribunal has also added Rs.88,000/- for loss of consortium.

5. In view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court Smt. Sarla Verma vs. Delhi Transport Corporation and Another, AIR 2009 SC 3104 (Two Judge Bench), in National Insurance Company Limited vs. Pranay Sethi and Others, AIR 2017 SC 5157 (Five Judge Constitution Bench) and in United India Insurance Company Limited vs. Satinder Kaur Alias Satwinder Kaur and Others ,
(2021) 11 SCC 780 (Three Judge Bench) and Kishangopal and Others Vs. Lala and another, AIR 2014 SCC (Suppl.) 173, it cannot be said that compensation awarded by the Tribunal is excessive or it is not just and proper.

6. In this Court's considered opinion, compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper and no reduction is required in the same.
7. Hence, appeal filed by the appellant is dismissed.
